build_FPG_neck: build a Feature Pyramid Grids neck module with configurable stack times and paths for object detection
create_UpInterpolationConv_transition: create an up-sampling transition that interpolates features then refines with a convolution layer
create_LastConv_transition: create a LastConv transition to refine the output of the last FPG stage with a convolution
review_FPG_forward: review the FPG forward pass that fuses features across multiple pyramid stages and directions
build_FPG_transitions: build FPG transitions including same-stage, across-lateral, across-down, across-up, and skip connections
